reference-data.country.column.name: Name
reference-data.country.footnote: Countries without a calling code or legal currency (such as Antarctica) show —.
reference-data.country.note: Names are localized by the console; the English name is the stored data and the fallback. Whether a country may onboard and its country risk belong to the jurisdiction packs and compliance, not to this page.
reference-data.country.search: Search code, alpha-3 code or name
reference-data.country.summary: {count, plural, one {# country} other {# countries}} · sorted by name
reference-data.country.viewSubdivisions: See all {count} on the Subdivisions tab
reference-data.detail.selectHint: Select a row to see its details
reference-data.empty.filtered: Nothing matches the current search or filter
reference-data.industry.footnote: Categories expand; only subcategories can be selected for a Client classification.
reference-data.industry.note: Whether an industry is allowed, needs approval or carries a risk level is configured in compliance, keyed by the industry code.
reference-data.industry.summary: {categories, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}} · {subcategories, plural, one {# subcategory} other {# subcategories}}
reference-data.mcc.column.name: Name
reference-data.mcc.footnote: Translations cover the MCCs suggested by subcategories; the rest show the English name.
reference-data.mcc.note: MCCs are ISO 18245 standard data. Whether the platform allows an MCC, needs approval or assigns a risk level is configured in compliance and risk, not on this page.
reference-data.mcc.summary: {count, plural, one {# match} other {# matches}} (code prefix or English name)
reference-data.page.intro: Currencies, countries, subdivisions, industries and MCCs shared by the whole platform. Currencies can be maintained online; the other reference data is maintained through reviewed SQL. Names follow the interface language and fall back to the English name when a translation is missing.
reference-data.subdivision.column.name: Name
reference-data.subdivision.footnote: Codes use the ISO 3166-2 hyphen format (AE-DU); older onboarding addresses stored as AE_DU are converted at release.
reference-data.subdivision.hint: The first batch covers AE, SA and EG; countries without subdivisions use a text box in onboarding addresses.
